subject: general
question: Amit, Gaurav, Hatim, Varun, Yukti and Zaid are sitting in a straight line, all facing the north. Gaurav is fourth to the left of Amit. Yukti is sitting at one corner. Hatim is fourth to the left of Yukti. Zaid is third to the right of Gaurav. Who is sitting at the second place to the left of Zaid?
solution:
Total 6 persons facing north:- Amit, Gaurav, Hatim, Varun, Yukti and Zaid.

1) Hatim is fourth to the left of Yukti.

2) Yukti is sitting at one corner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/235ef99a10636105a051d398cd80f1ed87ba366691592f61f1b85485915684c6.png] 

3) Gaurav is fourth to the left of Amit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/786f9194873351875701a6b974563f55f67f5151e25f8f3702332362ef2e0456.png] 

4) Zaid is third to the right of Gaurav.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58586aab49082da2f5d5df490c59e45a205145d995238668d7a79d90d9a4fd2d.png] 

5) Only Varun is left which is sitting in a blank place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf6e35782133bfe7673109114fda7940295ef2fbb686dd9e846ef465a0841288.png] 

Hence, 'Hatim' is sitting in the second place to the left of Zaid.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Hatim".**
